name: San Pablo Summer Internship Program
org: City of San Pablo Youth, School, and Community Partnerships
what_you_do: Work a paid summer internship in a city department. You get hands-on experience in local government and build job skills. In 2025 the city hosted nine interns.
who_can_apply: Youth who are 15 and a half or older and are in school or are recent high school graduates.
pay_detail: Paid internship. The pay rate is not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The page says applications open every January and are due in March. The exact dates for next year are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply on the city job site, linked as Employment Opportunities on the program page. Watch for the posting in January.
notes: The minimum age is 15 and a half on the page. It is stored here as 15. The same page also describes a UC Berkeley Public Service Internship. It hosts UC Berkeley interns for an academic year in a city department or division.
